h1: Three launches, three different conversion risks
room_line: LAUT BERCERITA has the stronger quality-led test: two independent finished-film reviews versus The Doll Ghawiah’s 1.41M-view campaign post but no independent finished-film review. Neither has proven demand; The Longest Wait remains affinity-led.
coming_kick: The room advantage is not choosing a winner from public reach; it is defining local, ordinary comparisons that can expose conversion.
coming_caveat: Domestic play is a working assumption, not confirmed booking or DCP. Explicit exclusion and fixed, promo, event, NOBAR, NOMAT or support context override it. Public-source inventory; XXI unavailable. LSF: 229 undated entries; 0 acquisition gaps, 1 date conflicts. Other releases may be missing; SAMS bookings unconfirmed.
signal_note: The Doll Ghawiah's strongest sampled TikTok had 1.41M views; The Longest Wait's had 268,253; LAUT BERCERITA's related mixed reel had 10,175 views and 1,524 likes. These unlike samples describe signal shape, not a demand ranking.

eligibility.basis: Captured booking_status is UNCONFIRMED, and no in-window match appeared on the SAMS public Coming surface. Public release evidence is discovery only and does not confirm private SAMS eligibility.

coming.meta: Jadwalnonton: Reza Rahadian and Pal 8 Pictures lead a prestige package with Dian Sastrowardoyo, Christine Hakim, Yunita Siregar and Eva Celia. Decision: use cast credibility to support exploration, never as booking or demand proof.
coming.logline: Film Indonesia: in late-1990s Yogyakarta, student activist Biru Laut disappears, leaving family and friends to seek truth and justice. Decision: frame it as adult family-and-memory drama and test book or history affinity, not generic activism.
coming.quality: Strong, accessible emotional drama: two current-film reviews praise its involving performances, controlled visual atmosphere and clearer linear storytelling, while one notes some unnatural foley sound.
coming.gold: Adult prestige event with conversion potential: a bestselling literary adaptation, major cast, accessible execution and BIFF exposure create a strong proposition for educated adult and book-community audiences, not yet a proven mass-market floor.
coming.promo: Eventfest and ANTARA confirm a trailer, poster, BIFF premiere, Jakarta gala and literary-history discussion. Decision: isolate gala, community, promo and fixed shows; credit none as ordinary demand.
coming.social: Social read is inconclusive: one current author-and-history Instagram reel reached 10,175 views and 1,524 likes, but the sample mixes film, book and unrelated material, while the TikTok capture returned no usable sample.
coming.demand: ANTARA confirms the 29 October release, but no captured source verifies paid presales, sell-through, SAMS booking or local purchase intent. Decision: keep only a working eligibility assumption and let eligible ordinary Nightly admissions govern allocation.
coming.risk: Adult-only, long and emotionally heavy: the 17+ classification, roughly 134–135-minute runtime, political violence and complex grief may narrow casual family appeal and reduce daily scheduling flexibility.
coming.bet: In comparable ordinary contexts, LAUT BERCERITA will beat each site's adult-drama ADM/show baseline at most sites by Day 4.
coming.nug: Accessible literary prestige: strong reviews, major talent and a recognised novel create an adult-audience bridge, but not a proven mass-market floor.

lanes.read: In late-1990s Yogyakarta, student activist Biru Laut disappears under an authoritarian regime, leaving his family and friends to pursue truth, justice and an uncertain homecoming.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia and ANTARA describe Biru Laut joining Winatra, disappearing with fellow activists and leaving his family to search for answers.
lanes.decision_consequence: Present it as an emotional family-and-memory drama rooted in political history, then test affinity among adult readers and historically engaged audiences rather than treating it as generic activism content.

lanes.read: Star-led domestic prestige package: Reza Rahadian leads with Dian Sastrowardoyo, Christine Hakim, Yunita Siregar and Eva Celia; Pal 8 Pictures is the producing banner, supported by VMS Studio, Jagartha, Lynx Films, Gambar Gerak Film and Brandlink.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched Jadwalnonton article directly names the principal cast, producers, Pal 8 Pictures as producer and the supporting production partners.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room can credit recognisable adult-skewing talent and a credible prestige package, but star power should support exploration rather than substitute for local booking or demand proof.

lanes.read: Strong, accessible emotional drama: two current-film reviews praise its involving performances, controlled visual atmosphere and clearer linear storytelling, while one notes some unnatural foley sound.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Teknogav scored the film 9.0/10 and praised its accessible narrative, cinematography and editing; Cantika independently reported sustained emotional impact, strong performances and one sound-design weakness.
lanes.decision_consequence: Quality evidence is strong enough to support confident audience-facing framing and a meaningful ordinary-context test, while the isolated sound criticism does not justify a programming discount.

lanes.read: Adult prestige event with conversion potential: a bestselling literary adaptation, major cast, accessible execution and BIFF exposure create a strong proposition for educated adult and book-community audiences, not yet a proven mass-market floor.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Current reviews describe a more commercial, readily understood adaptation, while captured launch coverage confirms the established novel, major cast and BIFF Main Competition premiere.
lanes.decision_consequence: Under the owner-authorized working assumption, keep it provisionally eligible for conditional ordinary-context exploration; do not call the booking confirmed or let prestige evidence determine site count or allocation.

lanes.read: Visible prestige-led launch campaign: the film has an official trailer and poster, BIFF world premiere, Jakarta gala and press activity, plus community-facing discussion around its literary and historical themes.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fetched coverage confirms the trailer-and-poster launch, BIFF premiere and a Jakarta gala press conference; captured social evidence also shows a current book-community activation.
lanes.decision_consequence: Ask which SAMS screenings carry cast, community, fixed or promotional obligations and isolate them; campaign activity must not be credited as ordinary demand.

lanes.read: Social read is inconclusive: one current author-and-history Instagram reel reached 10,175 views and 1,524 likes, but the sample mixes film, book and unrelated material, while the TikTok capture returned no usable sample.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured Instagram sample contains one relevant 2026 reel with measurable interaction, but only ten mixed-result entries overall; TikTok produced zero sampled posts.
lanes.missing_fact: A clean, current sample of official-film posts with comparable reach, comments, saves, shares and audience geography is missing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Give no social-demand credit and do not infer local SAMS attendance; use the Monday room to identify any site-level book-community affinity that can be tested separately from campaign screenings.

lanes.read: Purchase signal remains unverified: readable sources confirm a 29 October national release, but the captured full text does not establish paid presale volume, sell-through, SAMS bookings or locally attributable purchase intent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA directly confirms the nationwide 29 October release; no readable captured source verifies an advance-sales quantity or SAMS-specific purchase signal.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified paid presale volume with coverage, capacity, sales period and SAMS site attribution, plus current private booking or DCP confirmation, is missing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the domestic-release rule as a working eligibility assumption unless the room states an exclusion, but claim neither confirmed booking nor demand and let Nightly evidence—not Monday publicity—govern allocation.

lanes.read: Adult-only, long and emotionally heavy: the 17+ classification, roughly 134–135-minute runtime, political violence and complex grief may narrow casual family appeal and reduce daily scheduling flexibility.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Cantika identifies the 17+ classification, adult material, violence and narrative complexity; Teknogav records a 134-minute runtime and serious historical subject.
lanes.decision_consequence: Test in suitable adult-oriented ordinary sessions, avoid assuming family breadth, and compare only against eligible contexts with similar slot quality; promo, fixed, NOMAT and event shows must remain excluded.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Strong quality read: two current reviews converge on emotion, performances and visuals; one flags unnatural foley.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Conditional local relevance: the domestic-release rule supports working eligibility, not confirmed SAMS booking or DCP.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Unverified purchase signal: the 29 October national release is confirmed; paid presales and SAMS-attributable demand are not.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Visible campaign, weak social read: trailer, poster, BIFF and Jakarta gala are proven; one related reel had 10,175 views and 1,524 likes, but the mixed sample and absent TikTok sample cannot evidence attendance.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Adult-skewing constraint: 17+, political violence, complex grief and roughly 135 minutes may narrow casual family appeal.
ai_rating.actionability: Monday asks: Is there an exclusion or unavailable booking? Which contexts are fixed, promo, event or otherwise non-ordinary? Is there local book or history affinity? Is a matched adult-drama ordinary comparison available? Exclusion means monitor only; non-ordinary contexts are isolated; affinity strengthens the prior without proving demand; no comparator means NOT_TESTABLE.

eligibility.basis: Captured booking_status is UNCONFIRMED, and no in-window match appeared on the SAMS public Coming surface. Public release evidence does not establish private booking or DCP eligibility.

coming.meta: LSF: Titi Kamal, Darius Sinathrya and Sara Wijayanto lead a Rocky Soraya production from Legacy Pictures, Hitmaker Studios and Masih Belajar Project. Decision: treat the package as awareness support, not a show-count premium.
coming.logline: LSF: after a family moves to Bandung in 1988, Ghawiah—a doll tied to a child killed in a hit-and-run—haunts them. Decision: compare it only with ordinary domestic horror, not unlike drama or documentary launches.
coming.quality: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the production emphasizes expensive animatronics and a cinematic approach, but no readable independent review or audience-quality verdict was captured.
coming.gold: Franchise-led horror with visible reach: familiar talent, The Doll continuity and an active campaign make it a credible conditional exploration title, but awareness has not yet shown paid conversion.
coming.promo: Indopos and the captured campaign sample show press activity, repeated 29 October calls to action and a prize-backed CapCut activation. Decision: isolate promo, premiere and event shows before reading ordinary demand.
coming.social: Large but concentrated social signal: one TikTok reached 1.41 million views and another 258,476, while most sampled posts were far smaller; the sample is directional and may be campaign-driven.
coming.demand: The captured sources show release messaging and campaign reach but no presale volume, seat movement, sell-out or verified purchase intent. Decision: do not translate views into shows; use eligible ordinary Day-1 ADM/show to test conversion.
coming.risk: Conversion risk is material: the film is classified 17+, quality and purchase intent remain unproven, and local SAMS booking is not confirmed despite broad public release claims.
coming.bet: The Doll Ghawiah will match or beat its named horror comparator and reach 10 ADM/show on Day 1 and 6 on Day 4.
coming.nug: The Doll continuity and a 1.41M-view TikTok create an awareness head start, but uneven reach and no paid-demand proof keep the edge conditional.

lanes.read: Haunted-doll family horror: after moving to Bandung in 1988, a struggling family becomes entangled with Ghawiah, a doll connected to a child killed in a hit-and-run.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched LSF record directly describes the family, the doll, the dead child Uci and Laras's attempt to end its vengeance.
lanes.decision_consequence: The clear supernatural-family premise is easy to communicate and fits an established Indonesian horror audience.

lanes.read: Recognizable horror package: Titi Kamal, Darius Sinathrya and Sara Wijayanto lead a Rocky Soraya production from Legacy Pictures, Hitmaker Studios and Masih Belajar Project.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The regulatory LSF entry directly lists the principal cast, producer and three production companies.
lanes.decision_consequence: Known cast, producer and franchise-linked studio provide a stronger awareness prior than an unknown original horror title.

lanes.read: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the production emphasizes expensive animatronics and a cinematic approach, but no readable independent review or audience-quality verdict was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Rocky Soraya describes a costly animatronic doll and an intended A-movie treatment; Letterboxd explicitly reports that ratings and reviews are not yet available.
lanes.missing_fact: A credible independent post-screening review or a verified audience-quality sample for the finished film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat production ambition as a presentation positive, not a quality premium; do not enlarge the Monday prior on craft claims alone.

lanes.read: Franchise-led horror with visible reach: familiar talent, The Doll continuity and an active campaign make it a credible conditional exploration title, but awareness has not yet shown paid conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The title extends The Doll franchise, while one captured TikTok sample reached 1,414,192 views and 61,756 likes before release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Carry a positive but bounded opening prior under the domestic-release working assumption; Monday frames the test and Nightly alone responds to measured performance.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign: press activity, repeated release-date calls to action and a CapCut transformation activation are visible, but campaign intensity does not establish film quality or ticket sales.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured TikTok and Instagram samples show repeated October 29 messaging and a CapCut campaign offering an iPad and CapCut prizes.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect meaningful opening awareness, but isolate any promo, premiere or event-supported shows from ordinary-demand evaluation.

lanes.read: Large but concentrated social signal: one TikTok reached 1.41 million views and another 258,476, while most sampled posts were far smaller; the sample is directional and may be campaign-driven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured ten-post TikTok sample contains two substantial reach outliers alongside several posts below 10,000 views.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use social reach as an awareness prior, not as a network-wide demand estimate; site-level admissions must decide continuation.

lanes.read: Ticket demand remains insufficient evidence: captured reach and nationwide-release messaging show awareness, but no presale volume, seat movement, sell-out or verified purchase-intent signal was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The purchase-proximity fetch confirms an October 29 cinema release but contains no ticket-sales or advance-booking result.
lanes.missing_fact: Paid presale volume, seat inventory movement or comparable purchase-proximity evidence before opening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not translate views into shows; retain only a conditional opening prior and let eligible ordinary Day-1 admissions reveal conversion.

lanes.read: Conversion risk is material: the film is classified 17+, quality and purchase intent remain unproven, and local SAMS booking is not confirmed despite broad public release claims.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF classifies the 110-minute film for audiences aged 17 and above; captured sources provide campaign reach but no paid-demand proof.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the domestic-release rule only as a working assumption. An explicit booking or DCP exclusion removes the test; fixed, promo, event or NOMAT contexts must be isolated.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High on identity and campaign; costly animatronics and A-movie ambition lack an independent finished-film review.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Conditional: the domestic-release working assumption applies, but no SAMS booking is confirmed and explicit exclusion overrides it.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: the October 29 release is verified, but no presale, seat movement, sell-out or purchase-intent evidence was captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Strong but concentrated: TikTok reached 1.41M and 258,476 views, while most sampled posts were much smaller.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Material: 17+, 110 minutes, unproven quality and conversion; fixed, promo, event and NOMAT contexts require isolation.
ai_rating.actionability: Monday: confirm local eligibility or explicit booking/DCP exclusion; exclusion removes the test. Identify fixed, promo, event or NOMAT context; isolate those rows. State local horror/franchise affinity; weak affinity lowers priority. Name an eligible ordinary comparator; without comparable play, mark NOT_TESTABLE.

eligibility.basis: Private SAMS booking is unconfirmed, and no in-window match appeared on the SAMS public Coming surface. The public surface cannot establish ordinary eligibility or event status.

coming.meta: LSF and Fremantle identify Rizki Ridho, Thom Haye, Shayne Pattynama, Egy Maulana Vikri, Justin Hubner and Beckham Putra in a Fremantle–Beach House documentary. Decision: target football affinity; do not frame it as star-led fiction.
coming.logline: Fremantle and Skor: players, staff and supporters navigate pressure, sacrifice and hope through Timnas Indonesia’s football journey. Decision: compare it with a community-led ordinary release, not fiction by screen count.
coming.quality: Promising emotional and access-led feel: Skor found the trailer's camera work and editing affecting, but this is a trailer response rather than an independent verdict on the completed film.
coming.gold: Clear football-community proposition: exclusive Timnas access, national identity and a Youth Pledge Day launch give supporters a specific reason to care, but broad affinity is not yet proven theatrical conversion.
coming.promo: Fremantle confirms the GBK trailer-and-soundtrack activation, Morfem performance and AQUA sponsorship. Decision: ask whether awareness converts locally and isolate promo, event and NOBAR shows.
coming.social: Visible social reach with uneven depth: one relevant TikTok sample reached 268,253 views, 27,099 likes and 469 shares, while other film posts ranged from under 1,000 to more than 155,000 views; the sample is directional, not representative.
coming.demand: The producer and captured social sample establish cinema availability and attention, but no presale, seat, sell-out or paid-admission evidence. Decision: assign no exploration floor from awareness; let eligible ordinary Nightly admissions decide.
coming.risk: Execution risk is context, not awareness: domestic origin supports the owner-authorized working assumption that it plays, and one social sample mentions Sam’s Studios, but neither proves a site booking, DCP, ordinary context or absence of special obligations.
coming.bet: In comparable ordinary play, The Longest Wait will beat one same-site comparator on ADM/show on both Day 1 and Day 4.
coming.nug: Exclusive Timnas access, national identity and a Youth Pledge Day launch create a focused football-community proposition, not proven broad theatrical demand.

lanes.read: Intimate Timnas Indonesia documentary: players, staff and supporters navigate pressure, sacrifice and shared hope during the national team's pursuit of football progress.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The producer and independent coverage describe a feature documentary built from extensive behind-the-scenes access to Timnas Indonesia.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat it as a football-community documentary rather than a conventional narrative release when choosing its audience comparison.

lanes.read: Timnas talent with established documentary producers: Rizki Ridho, Thom Haye, Shayne Pattynama, Egy Maulana Vikri, Justin Hubner and Beckham Putra feature in a Fremantle Indonesia and Beach House Pictures production.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF lists the featured players, while the producer's own page identifies Fremantle Indonesia and Beach House Pictures.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognisable Timnas participants and production access are the primary sell; do not frame this as star-led fiction.

lanes.read: Promising emotional and access-led feel: Skor found the trailer's camera work and editing affecting, but this is a trailer response rather than an independent verdict on the completed film.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Skor reports that the trailer communicates emotion through its footage and editing and highlights unusually personal team access.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use emotional authenticity as a prior, not a quality guarantee; Monday should not award a stronger floor without a completed-film review or audience result.

lanes.read: Clear football-community proposition: exclusive Timnas access, national identity and a Youth Pledge Day launch give supporters a specific reason to care, but broad affinity is not yet proven theatrical conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The film combines behind-the-scenes Timnas access with a nationally symbolic release moment and supporter-focused positioning.
lanes.decision_consequence: Target the Timnas-affinity audience and test against another community-led release, not against a general-audience title solely by screen count.

lanes.read: High-visibility campaign activation: the trailer and Morfem soundtrack launched through a surprise GBK performance after a Timnas match, with AQUA named as principal sponsor.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The producer directly documents the GBK activation, Morfem performance, official soundtrack and AQUA sponsorship.
lanes.decision_consequence: Awareness support is credible, so Monday should focus its question on conversion and local context rather than whether a campaign exists.

lanes.read: Visible social reach with uneven depth: one relevant TikTok sample reached 268,253 views, 27,099 likes and 469 shares, while other film posts ranged from under 1,000 to more than 155,000 views; the sample is directional, not representative.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Nine title-relevant posts in the captured ten-result sample show substantial but highly variable attention immediately before release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Record awareness and engagement as live signals, but do not convert them into an admissions forecast without transactional or opening-day evidence.

lanes.read: Insufficient evidence of ticket demand: the bundle proves campaign reach and announced cinema availability but captures no presale volume, seat occupancy, sold-out sessions or attributable purchase intent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The producer announces a nationwide cinema premiere, and social posts show attention, but neither source provides transactional behavior.
lanes.missing_fact: Site-level presale or seat-map movement, paid admissions, or another direct purchase-proximity measure.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not assign an exploration floor from awareness alone; retain a conditional Monday comparison and let Nightly react to actual admissions per show.

lanes.read: Execution risk is context, not awareness: domestic origin supports the owner-authorized working assumption that it plays, and one social sample mentions Sam’s Studios, but neither proves a site booking, DCP, ordinary context or absence of special obligations.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF identifies Indonesia as the country of production, while a captured social post says the film will play at Sam’s Studios on October 29; site and account provenance remain unbound.
lanes.decision_consequence: Monday must confirm site-level play, ordinary versus promo/event/NOBAR/NOMAT/support/fixed context, local football affinity and a same-site ordinary comparator. Confirmed ordinary answers make the comparison testable; any context mismatch makes it NOT_TESTABLE. Nightly alone allocates.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High on identity and campaign; medium on feel because Skor assessed the trailer, not the completed film.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Working assumption: domestic play. Monday confirms local eligibility; eligible keeps the test, unavailable removes it.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: no presales, seat maps, sold-out sessions, paid admissions or other purchase-proximity evidence.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: High but uneven: GBK launch, Morfem soundtrack, AQUA sponsor; TikTok ranged from under 1,000 to 268,253 views.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Confirm ordinary versus promo/event/NOBAR/NOMAT/support/fixed context; any mismatch makes the test NOT_TESTABLE.
ai_rating.actionability: Confirm local football affinity and a same-site ordinary comparator; weak affinity lowers confidence, while no comparator makes it NOT_TESTABLE.

playing.note: 644 ADM across 57 shows; site results ranged from 0.67 APS at Pasuruan to 39.8 at Subang.
431 ADM across 48 shows, with wide local variation from 1.0 APS at Klaten to 20.33 at Cianjur.
409 ADM across 29 shows; local results ranged from 2.0 APS at Pemalang to 41.5 at Salatiga.
385 ADM across 40 shows, led by 46.0 APS at Solo while several sites remained below 5.0.
201 ADM across 24 shows; strong single-site results coexisted with 1.0 APS at Nganjuk.
92 ADM across 13 shows; Subang reached 16.5 APS, while several sites recorded 0–4 APS.

58 ADM across 29 shows; five sites recorded zero ADM and no site exceeded 6.0 APS.

now_meta.basisKick: The reconciled 2026-10-24 observation is 2,299 ADM across 241 shows, or 9.54 ADM/show.
now_meta.sourceNote: This uses matching raw site-title and title-summary totals for SAMS-owned sites. The conflicting 2,220 ADM / 240-show benchmark denominator is quarantined; no cause is asserted and no historical ratio is mixed into this observation.

attention_heading: THREE DECISIONS TO SHARPEN IN THE ROOM

attention.label: Do not promote reach into demand
attention.why: The Doll Ghawiah has the largest observed public post, but none of the three titles has paid-demand or SAMS-attributable conversion evidence.
attention.action: Use reach only as a prior; resolve eligibility, context, affinity and a valid comparator.

attention.label: Back the strongest conversion mechanism
attention.why: LAUT BERCERITA has independent quality evidence and a literary-adult bridge; The Longest Wait relies more narrowly on football-community affinity.
attention.action: Test each mechanism against a matched ordinary comparator, not against unlike social samples.

attention.label: Make local variation visible first
attention.why: Private SAMS results show that the same title can occupy radically different local positions, making network averages commercially incomplete.
attention.action: Require site-level ordinary context before interpreting later ADM/show outcomes.

what_milo_sees.title: The Doll Ghawiah
what_milo_sees.insight: Measured: one TikTok reached 1.41M views, but the campaign is concentrated and no purchase signal exists. Prediction: franchise familiarity can convert horror audiences. Unresolved: local eligibility, ordinary context, affinity and comparator.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Is The Doll Ghawiah locally eligible under the working assumption, free of fixed, promo, event or NOMAT exclusions, supported by local horror or franchise affinity, and paired with an eligible ordinary horror comparator?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Eligibility is affirmed, play is ordinary, local horror or franchise affinity is credible, and the room names a comparable domestic horror title.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: There is an explicit exclusion or unavailable booking, weak local horror affinity, non-ordinary context, or no eligible comparator.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Retain awareness as a conditional prior if no exclusion is known; if ordinary context or comparator remains unresolved, mark the comparison NOT_TESTABLE and infer no performance advantage.

public_signal_shape.metric: Views on strongest sampled TikTok post
public_signal_shape.comparison: Numerically above reported sampled peaks for The Longest Wait and LAUT BERCERITA, but the samples are unlike and cannot establish superior demand.

what_milo_sees.evidence: Franchise continuity, known cast and one 1.41M-view TikTok support awareness. A second sampled TikTok had 258,476 views and most sampled posts were smaller; no presale, seat movement or paid-admission evidence was captured.

what_milo_sees.title: LAUT BERCERITA
what_milo_sees.insight: Measured: two independent reviews converge on emotion, performances and visuals; social evidence is a mixed 10,175-view reel. Prediction: literary prestige can convert adult audiences. Unresolved: local eligibility, affinity and a matched adult-drama baseline.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Is LAUT BERCERITA locally eligible under the working assumption, free of fixed, promo, event or NOMAT exclusions, supported by local book, history or adult-drama affinity, and testable against a slot-matched ordinary adult-drama baseline?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Eligibility is affirmed, play is ordinary, relevant local affinity exists, and the room can name a credible slot-matched adult-drama baseline.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: There is an explicit exclusion or unavailable booking, weak adult-drama affinity, non-ordinary context, or no matched baseline.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Keep the quality-led hypothesis conditional if no exclusion is known; without a matched ordinary baseline, record NOT_TESTABLE and infer no local demand floor.
